queries: htonl ntohl network byte order conversion
bit twiddling hacks population count trailing zeros

leaves.leaf: Random number generation APIs (rand, random, drand48, arc4random, getrandom)
leaves.scope: Pseudo-random and cryptographically secure random number interfaces available to C programs: ISO rand/srand and RAND_MAX, BSD random, the drand48 family's LCG parameters, arc4random, getrandom/getentropy and Windows rand_s.
queries: rand srand RAND_MAX implementation linear congruential

leaves.leaf: Real-time operating system C APIs (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, RTEMS, VxWorks)
leaves.scope: C programming interfaces of RTOS kernels used in embedded systems, including FreeRTOS tasks, queues and configuration macros, Zephyr kernel services and devicetree, RTEMS, VxWorks, ThreadX and µC/OS.
queries: Zephyr RTOS kernel API k_thread devicetree
RTEMS VxWorks ThreadX real-time operating system

leaves.leaf: Memory-safety extensions for C (CHERI C, Checked C, bounds-safety, Fil-C, MTE)
leaves.scope: Research and industry efforts to add spatial and temporal memory safety to C, such as CHERI C capabilities and Morello, Checked C, Clang's bounds-safety annotations, Fil-C, SoftBound/CETS and Arm MTE and pointer authentication.
queries: Checked C Microsoft Research checked pointers
Arm Memory Tagging Extension pointer authentication

leaves.leaf: C benchmark programs and suites (Dhrystone, Whetstone, CoreMark, SPEC CPU)
leaves.scope: Benchmarks written in C and their history, such as Dhrystone, the C port of Whetstone, CoreMark, the C programs in the SPEC CPU suites, MiBench and the Computer Language Benchmarks Game.
queries: SPEC CPU2017 benchmarks C language integer

leaves.leaf: Classic C books and reference works (Harbison & Steele, Plauger, Koenig, Modern C)
leaves.scope: Influential C books other than K&R, with their authors and editions: Harbison & Steele's C: A Reference Manual, Plauger's The Standard C Library, Koenig's C Traps and Pitfalls, van der Linden's Expert C Programming, Hanson's C Interfaces and Implementations and Gustedt's Modern C.
queries: C Reference Manual Harbison Steele edition
Expert C Programming Deep Secrets van der Linden
C Traps and Pitfalls Andrew Koenig
Modern C Jens Gustedt book edition

leaves.leaf: BSD and macOS/Darwin system interfaces (kqueue, pledge/unveil, Capsicum, libdispatch, Mach)
leaves.scope: C APIs found on FreeBSD, OpenBSD, NetBSD and Darwin/macOS but not on Linux, including kqueue/kevent filters, OpenBSD pledge promises and unveil, FreeBSD Capsicum capability mode, Grand Central Dispatch (libdispatch) and Mach ports, and the OS release in which each appeared.
queries: OpenBSD pledge unveil system call promises
Grand Central Dispatch libdispatch dispatch_async queue

leaves.leaf: eBPF programs in restricted C (libbpf, BTF, CO-RE, XDP)
leaves.scope: Kernel eBPF programs written in restricted C and compiled with clang -target bpf, then loaded through libbpf: helper functions, map and program types, BTF and CO-RE relocations, verifier limits, XDP/tc/kprobe attach points, and the kernel version that introduced each feature.
queries: XDP program verifier instruction complexity limit

leaves.leaf: JIT and runtime code-generation libraries with C APIs (libgccjit, LLVM-C, GNU lightning, libtcc, DynASM)
leaves.scope: Libraries that let a C program generate and run machine code at runtime, covering their API entry points, intermediate representations, supported architectures and release history: libgccjit, the LLVM-C API, GNU lightning, libtcc, DynASM and MIR.

leaves.leaf: Memory-corruption vulnerability classes and notable C security bugs
leaves.scope: Security defect classes typical of C code (stack and heap buffer overflows, format-string attacks, use-after-free, double free, integer overflow, off-by-one), their CWE identifiers, and well-known exploited C vulnerabilities such as the Morris worm, Heartbleed and Stagefright with their CVE numbers and dates.
queries: stack buffer overflow CWE-121 strcpy exploit
Morris worm fingerd gets buffer overflow 1988

leaves.leaf: Message catalogs and character-set conversion (gettext, catgets, iconv, ICU4C)
leaves.scope: Internationalization of C programs through GNU gettext and libintl (xgettext, msgfmt, .po/.mo formats, ngettext plural forms), X/Open catgets message catalogs, POSIX iconv encoding conversion and the ICU4C C API, as distinct from setlocale and wide-character handling.
queries: xgettext msgfmt po mo file format

leaves.leaf: High-level synthesis of hardware from C (Vitis HLS, Intel HLS Compiler, LegUp, Bambu, Catapult)
leaves.scope: Tools and coding conventions that turn C code into FPGA or ASIC hardware: HLS pragmas (pipeline, unroll, array partition, interface), arbitrary-precision types, the C subsets each tool supports, and the history of tools such as Vivado/Vitis HLS, Catapult, LegUp and Bambu.
queries: Vitis HLS pragma PIPELINE initiation interval
LegUp high-level synthesis C to Verilog

leaves.leaf: C compiler testing and conformance validation suites (Csmith, C-Reduce, Plum Hall, SuperTest, GCC torture tests)
leaves.scope: How C compilers are tested for correctness and standard conformance: random program generators (Csmith, YARPGen), test-case reducers (C-Reduce, C-Vise), commercial validation suites (Plum Hall, Perennial, Solid Sands SuperTest), and compiler test suites such as GCC's c-torture/DejaGnu tests and the LLVM test-suite.
queries: Csmith random C program generator compiler bugs
Plum Hall validation suite C conformance
